import json,collections
r=[json.loads(x) for x in open('items.jsonl')]; a=[json.loads(x) for x in open('answers.jsonl')]
for x,y in zip(r[len(a):],['baseline dot','space','hyphen','baseline dot']):a.append(dict(item_id=x['item_id'],answer=next(k for k,v in x['options'].items() if v==y),confidence='high',note=''))

assert len(a)==len(r)==84
assert [x['item_id'] for x in a]==[x['item_id'] for x in r]
assert all(x['answer'] in q['options'] for q,x in zip(r,a))
assert all(x['confidence'] in ['high','low'] for x in a)
print('Validated count, order, option letters:',len(a))
print(json.dumps(collections.Counter(q['options'][x['answer']] for q,x in zip(r,a)),sort_keys=True))
print('Low confidence:',sum(x['confidence']=='low' for x in a))
